admission: All9 actual successful direct-wait/raw-owner/owned-absence terminals plus exact source/completion/selected-logit headers/hashes are bound before VALID bytes/arrays are read. Whole9needed regardless of screen pass/fail; no partial family.
common_rival_definition: For each VALID node and each false class f, compare stored raw FP32 logits[f]>logits[true] strictly in every member. Count its existence, false/true class matrix,0/1/2common-rival histogram, clearing/appearance and the actual FP32 pool crossing count.
mathematical_limit: All-member argmax wrong alone is not a convex-pooling obstruction in multiclass prediction. A common false class strictly above true in every member is a sufficient real-arithmetic obstruction after softmax; absence is not a feasibility proof. Report actual FP32 pool counts without forcing zero crossings or changing any mask.
mismatch: Stop and preserve FAILURE.json with original input custody and expected/derived signatures; no partial count publication, forward, refit, threshold/backend retry or floating-point mismatch chasing.
prediction_operation: On exact bound original Torch/runtime/cuda:0, original contiguous float32 full factual bank[4,19717,3]. probabilities=bank.softmax(-1).mean(0); pooled=probabilities[valid_ids].argmax(-1); members=bank[:,valid_ids].argmax(-1). No casts, calibrated pool, threshold, model forward, checkpoint or rescore.
quality_outputs: Integer error/coverage/repair/common-rival counts only, overall and perclass. Core-own fixed shared-route member pairing; independent references compared only at bank/coverage level. True repair intersections, never sums of purported disjoint aggregate counts.
verification: Every saved ordered pooled/member prediction and correct-mask dtype/shape/C-order SHA must match exactly; all original integer VALID/class correct counts and selected epoch lineage must match. No NLL/accuracy float comparison is used.
